notes.title: Echoes of the Culture: A Living Knowledge System
notes.content:
[h1]Where Art Speaks & Knowledge Grows[/h1]
Step into a world where history isn't just displayed—it speaks. Visitors in your museum will have dynamic, voiced dialogues, commenting on exhibits, debating perspectives, and reacting to discoveries.

🎭 [b]Immersive Visitor Reactions[/b] – Hear unique, quality-driven takes on artworks.

🧠 [b]Knowledge & Researching System[/b] – Gather insights from NPCs and channel them into expanding your museum’s themes.

🌍 [b]Science or Tourism? You Decide[/b] – Use collected information to advance research or attract new visitors.
